name: Shaking Strength in Bounds
hint: Shaking strength is measured from 0 to 100, allowing movement reactions to be based on a dependable reading.
instruction: Compare shaking strength with thresholds from 0 to 100 and validate the reading before evaluating it.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB shaking strength :: sensing) > (50)> then
say [Strong shaking]
end
